by_air.nearest_airport: Tirupati International Airport (TIR / Renigunta) - 38 km from Tirumala (14 km from Tirupati). Daily direct flights from Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi, and Vijayawada.

by_train.connectivity: Direct superfast trains connect all major Indian cities.

by_bus.local_connectivity: APSRTC operates non-stop 'Sapthagiri Link Bus Express' and zero-emission electric buses running every 2 minutes 24/7 between Tirupati Railway Station / Central Bus Station and Tirumala.
